kernels.label: Demo image mean score
kernels.description: Fixture scalar for CI/mock and Wiki demos. Converts the camera frame to float RGB in [0,1] (NCHW) and returns the mean intensity of all pixels. Bright images score near 1.0; dark images near 0.0. Not a physical beam metric — use curated feature kernels or a session kernel for centroid/radius work.

kernels.label: Demo center ROI mean
kernels.description: Mean intensity over the center half of the frame (crop H/4..3H/4, W/4..3W/4) after RGB float normalization. Useful when you care about the middle of the camera FOV rather than the full sensor.

kernels.label: Demo peak intensity
kernels.description: Maximum channel intensity in the normalized RGB frame (max over C,H,W). Tracks the brightest pixel — a crude peak-power proxy for mock demos.
